disposition_reason: Acute 96 h waterborne molybdate exposure of rainbow trout up to 1000 mg/L; no stress response; tissue uptake data from a laboratory exposure, not food occurrence.

study.method: ICP-MS for tissue Mo; ELISA, Western blot for stress markers

regulatory_or_exposure: British Columbia aquatic-life guideline 2 mg/L molybdenum used as lowest test concentration (Methods, p. 3)
Reported 96 h LC50 in freshwater fish more than 50 to more than 10,000 mg/L as sodium molybdate (p. 2; secondary)
non_numeric_findings: Control juvenile tissue molybdenum: gill 6.0, plasma 10.5, white muscle 46.5, liver 227 ng/g dry weight (Results, p. 6)
No change in cortisol, glucose, hematocrit, hsp70, hsp90 or metallothionein up to 1000 mg/L (Abstract, p. 1)
